unknown.reason: No JCL step runs it, and 28 reachable computed calls could target it. Its DDs (DALYTRAN, TRANFILE, XREFFILE, CARDFILE, ACCTFILE, CUSTFILE) are not mapped by any JCL in the tree. It reads the same daily transaction file as CBTRN02C, so it may be a pre-posting verification run by hand. Do not delete.

The online report screen CORPT00C builds JCL text that runs this proc and submits it at run time. No static edge exists, so it is unknown, not unreachable. It is part of the transaction report must-not-break item.
